summary: We have developed an immersive virtual reality experience that explains the causes and consequences of climate change as it relates to glaciers in Antarctica. Additionally, we created an algorithm using data from the EIC that captures sea temperature anomalies in Antarctica to analyze their impact on these glaciers. This data is then transformed into sonifications, where the frequency of a sound rises or falls in response to changes in the temperature anomalies. This approach addresses the challenge by converting EIC data into intuitive, immersive sonifications, which complement the visualizations generated through virtual reality. This is significant for raising awareness about climate change and its environmental consequences, while also enabling people to analyze temperature data in a more intuitive way.
details:
This project helps people understand the causes and consequences of climate changespecifically its impact on glaciers in Antarctica through a virtual reality experience. It employs an algorithm that transforms climate data into "sonifications," capturing sea-surface temperature anomalies around Antarctica and representing them through sound; the frequency of the audio shifts depending on whether temperatures rise or fall. The experience is delivered via an application installed on a Meta Quest 3S headset, providing an immersive, audiovisual, and sensory encounter. By offering a more intuitive and engaging way to explore the subject, the project aims to raise awareness about climate change for a broad audience. Regarding the technical implementation, the VR experience was built using the Godot engine and the GDScript programming language. The algorithm was developed in Python using NASA datasets within the VSCode environment, with the entire project created on laptop computers. This project is highly creative, as it utilizes unconventional tools and visualization methods to communicate a critical global issue climate change while prioritizing ease of use and intuitive understanding. It is primarily targeted at adolescents and adults, ranging in age from 12 to 60.

Ayuda a las personas a entender las causas y consecuencias del cambio climatico y que efectos tiene en los glaciares ubicados en la Antartida mediante una experiencia de realidad virtual y un algoritmo que transforma los datos del EIC en sonificaciones, capturando las anomalias en la temperatura de la superficie marina alrededor de la Antartida y comunicandolo mediante un sonido que cambia su frecuencia dependiendo de si la temperatura aumentan o decaen. Funciona gracias a una aplicacion instalada en el Meta Quest 3s la cual viene siendo la experiencia audiovisual y sensorial. Este proyecto busca concientizar a las personas sobre el cambio climatico mediante una experiencia mas intuitiva e inmersiva y beneficia a numerosas personas. Ya hablando de lo que se utilizo para el proyecto, utilizamos Godot como motor para la experiencia VR usando GDScript como lenguaje de codificacion, en cuanto al algoritmo se utilizo Python y datasets de la NASA en VSCode para llevarlo a cabo, ademas de computadoras portatiles para desarrollar la totalidad del proyecto. Este proyecto es creativo porque utiliza herramientas y formas de visualizacion no muy comunes para comunicar algo tan importante como lo es el cambio climatico, considerando factores de intuitividad y facilidad para entender, con un target principal que son los adolescentes y adultos (en la edad de entre 12-60 años).
projectRefs: Evaluación de una app de realidad aumentada para el aprendizaje sobre cambio climático en estudiantado universitarios: Estudio piloto
